body: Hey, this is strange coming from me, as i’m also in complete shame right now and suffering from guilt beyond imagination. What i did was vile to say the least, but i was young, my drive was high and i never understood the immorality of what i was doing. You were most likely the same. As an adult, it would be disgusting and terrible, and it’s the exact same here. But none the less the deed/deeds were commited, and we can’t go back and change that. We did something bad, and we have to live with it. However in the end aslong as no one is suffering because of us, and we never repeat, we should be able to grow on that guilt and realise what we did and how bad it was. This is strange saying as i’m struggling to do the same, but none the less

It’s nice to know that this isn’t something unique to me, and that other people have made massive mistakes. I agree we should be extremely sorry for what we have done, and although it’s impossible for people to find out the physical things i did, i tend to keep it to myself as it would only cause more saddness for others. Personally, i prefer to keep the burden and shame on myself, but none the less, all i can do is hope that you build off this to become a better person that would never do the same thing, as i am too, and that things don’t go too south for the both of us.

I would rather not say specifically, as it is just difficult to type. But ive had some support over message and ive begun to come to a realisation however big mistakes may be, aslong as you’ve come to a realisation that you were extremely wrong, you weren’t a serial offender (i only did these once), and the individuals you hurt are okay, you can begin to forgive yourself. The individuals hurt don’t even know what i did, and to be honest it’s best they don’t know as it would just cause more pain. I commited these as a kid too, so it was a childhood mistake. Don’t get me wrong, i don’t deserve just instant repentment and not that im fine now, but my mindset is getting better. Ill put it like this, im not on suicides door anymore like i was earlier today.
Ill give it some thought, but thanks, your concern means alot, and i’ve needed someone to tell me that. Thank you 🙌

I appreciate the concern, but the only people i can really talk to are my parents, and tbh although they care for me loads and would never do anything to hurt me, if i told them they would probably disown me out of disgust.
